name: Sarah Johnson
text: Urban Bite completely changed how I think about fast food! Every dish is fresh, flavorful, and made with obvious care. The staff is incredibly friendly too.

name: Marcus Chen
text: Best street tacos I've had outside of Mexico City! The ingredients are top-notch and the flavors are authentic. I'm a regular now.

name: Emma Rodriguez
text: Love bringing my kids here. The healthy bowl options are great, and everything is so tasty. Perfect for a quick family lunch.

name: James Mitchell
text: The Korean BBQ wrap is absolutely incredible. Complex flavors, perfectly balanced heat, and reasonable prices. Worth every penny!

name: Lisa Park
text: Finally found a place that takes food allergies seriously. Great communication about ingredients and always friendly. Highly recommend!
